before.port_5175_owner: stale L3-22 isolated bench frontend, not main

subsequent_refactor_transient.symptom: User observed Launcher unavailable while a large frontend refactor was landing.
frontend_log_errors: Failed to load url /src/app/App.js from src/main.tsx
Failed to load url /src/lib/queryClient.js from src/main.tsx
subsequent_refactor_transient.mechanism: Vite HMR reloaded main.tsx while refactor output was temporarily incomplete; the module graph could not be transformed and the browser rendered no application.

root_cause: The long-lived main process was started with the backend-only canonical CLI. That CLI intentionally registers start_frontend=false and never starts Vite. No process therefore owned reserved main frontend port 5173. A Vite listener on 5175 belonged to an isolated L3-22 bench restart and was not a main frontend fallback.
recovery: Added current-instance frontend recovery to the Instance Supervisor watchdog, made Vite strict-port, migrated main to Supervisor-owned backend/frontend PIDs, then killed the owned frontend process group and observed automatic recovery without restarting the backend.
residual_gap: Backend process death still requires an external Supervisor start/restart action; this fix closes the observed frontend-only Launcher outage while preserving the current-backend self-management prohibition.
follow_up: Keep main launches on InstanceSupervisor with start_frontend=true. Do not return to backend-only registration for the reserved main 49977/5173 pair.
